items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: The transcript mentions 'Tats' only as a name used by the interviewer to address the interviewee (Adolphe Alexander). There is no other person named 'Tats' mentioned in the text.

ctx.x: Anybody else in your family played music, Tats? Who? Anybody else in your family plays music?
Yeah, I got a brother, my brother used to play music, play piano. Play piano? My brother younger than me, yeah. Yeah. That's good. Yeah, he used to play piano.
